summary: Teucrium Commodity Trust filed an 8-K on August 31, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 that outstanding shares of its 7RCC Spot Bitcoin and Carbon Credit Futures ETF (BTCK, NYSE Arca) have fallen to the 50,000-share minimum, equal to five 10,000-share baskets. Per the prospectus, sponsor Teucrium Trading, LLC will reject redemption orders that would push shares below that threshold until new creation orders lift the count. The filing warns market makers may be less willing to buy shares, widening bid-ask spreads and increasing NAV deviation risk. No deal, price, or board action is involved.
